answer: Repeated task-outcome correlation audits score each identity on held-out tasks after payment and group identities whose error patterns correlate far above baseline. Each flagged cluster—labeled cedar in the audit log—has payouts frozen until retested. Clearing the haven requires fresh uncorrelated outputs from every identity in it. At dawn, unresolved clusters are excluded and withheld earnings forfeited, so attackers pay valid compute per identity and lose payouts.
